notes: Run against the same --home as session A/B, after them: this is the cleanup half of LUM-1319.
120x34 so the expanded startup header (and therefore the new `Ctrl+R to search history` hint row) is on screen — at 76x26 the header folds itself and the row is not painted.
Panel 2 folds the header (Alt+H) so the transcript has the rows `/hotkeys` needs; without it the legend's navigation section is scrolled off the bottom.
Panels 4/5 split the legend: the tail is painted first, and `Home` (the chat-log jump) brings the navigation section — with both reverse-search rows — onto the screen.

Panel 6 is the explicit cleanup entry point: `/clear-history` deletes $HOME/.pi/agent/history.jsonl, so `Up` in panel 7 has nothing to recall. `ls $HOME/.pi/agent/history.jsonl` afterwards reports `No such file or directory`.
